title: ADA Compliant Grab Bar 63-Inch 3-Post Wall Mount Iron Pipe For Bathroom, Pipeline Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Add steady support in the bathroom with this ADA compliant grab bar from the Pipeline collection. The extended 63-inch length and 3-post grab bar configuration (with a third center bracket) are designed to help provide stability and balance for everyday use. Its industrial pipe styling complements transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- ADA grab bar / ADA compliant grab bar for accessible bathroom use
- 3-post grab bar design with center bracket for enhanced stability
- Wall mount grab bar keeps floor space clear
- Iron pipe construction with a highly durable powder coat finish
- Designer finish delivers corrosion-free and rust-free performance

Specs:
- Overall length: 63 in
- Height: 3 in
- Width/Projection: 3.58 in
- Weight capacity: 250 lb
- Product weight: 5 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Limited lifetime warranty
- Available in multiple designer finish options

Designed with the needs of seniors, people with disabilities, and caregivers in mind, this grab bar provides balance, security, and ease of use. The industrial look of the Pipeline collection adds a modern touch to any bathroom decor, while the lifetime materials ensure a clean, decorative finish that lasts for years. With superior materials that are free from corrosion and rust, this grab bar is a reliable and stylish addition to your bathroom. Trust Allied Brass to provide high-quality bathroom fittings that enhance your safety and comfort.
